name: 14-manifest
description: manifest() lists every attribute name the product can write on a turn span, sorted by name: the schema names, the core names, the turn names and the registered names.
covers: practice 5: manifest() lists each declared name with its type, the truncated flags of strings and string arrays, the maxLength of strings, the enum values, renames and the core names
practice 5: manifest() lists no legacy app.<name>.<key> or app.<key> names for node keys
practice 5: the turn names are registered under the source turn when the package loads
practice 5: registerAttributes() adds a module's names to every manifest, and a second call with the same source replaces them
practice 5: when two sources write one name, the first keeps it
practice 1 and 5: each turn() call registers the turn names again, so a caller that replaces the turn source gets them back
practice 4: the self-check counts every manifest name for the whole turn
